prices.source: OpenAI's list prices for its API, standard tier, short context (at most 272K input tokens), as https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing published them on 2026-10-13; a Codex subject on a ChatGPT login is not billed per token, so the figure is the list price of the tokens Codex reported, and Codex reports cache writes as 0, so a written token is priced as uncached input, at most 20 % under OpenAI's cache-write price for it

caveats: Codex reports no cost: the figure is OpenAI's list price for the tokens it reported
the ChatGPT backend reports cache writes as 0, so written tokens are priced as uncached input, at most 20 % under OpenAI's write price
reasoning tokens are inside output, as OpenAI bills them
a ChatGPT plan is billed by usage windows, not per token: the run's windows are its bill
